## Problem

Link the existing issue when there is one. Explain the concrete error or improvement.

## Change

State the exact change and why it addresses the problem. Keep the diff focused.

## Evidence or check

Give exact sources, reproduction steps or appropriate validation. State uncertainty and checks not performed. Software tests are not required for a prose-only correction when they would not test its correctness.

## Rights

- [ ] I may share this material publicly, have identified third-party restrictions, and accept the target repository's [contribution](https://github.com/andydrewie/make-death-an-option/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [material-specific rights](https://github.com/andydrewie/make-death-an-option/blob/main/RIGHTS.md) terms. Accepted original companion/program material uses CC BY-SA 4.0; designated software uses Apache-2.0. Third-party works retain their rights. The article and reserved artwork have separate terms.

No private prompts, hidden reasoning, restricted records or unlicensed source bodies are requested. Humans and appropriately authorized agent submitters follow the same standards. Receipt is not acceptance or permission to act for the project.
